svg.title: Three-Stage Small-Diameter Well - Heating
svg.desc: Key: 热水 = hot water; 回灌水 = reinjection water; 回水 = return; 地热水 = geothermal water; 纳米保温管 = nano-insulated pipe; 真空保温管 = vacuum-insulated pipe; 地热分割器 = geothermal flow separator (source term). Source dimensions: 351 (unit not printed), >171 mm, 151 mm and an interval >500 m. Reference sketch, not approved well design.
